target_behavior: Recognize stalled or empty downstream state despite superficially healthy status signals.
failure_patterns: The model trusts success codes without checking whether expected state advanced.
The model underweights contradictions between heartbeats and completed work.
The model treats empty output as benign when non-empty input is known.
constraints: Never weaken page_now handling for explicit production data loss or total outages.
Include benign delays and development-only restarts as negative examples.
Do not include or infer hidden evaluation wording.
